column1: # METHOD: the same binary (retired ed25519 driver
column3: 37 requests) run with only the length of argv[0] changed. gem5 SE puts argv[0] on the initial stack
column4: so its length shifts stack alignment for the whole run; the signing code's stack buffers then land differently against the value predictor and DMP. Cycles moved -4%..+4% for both arms
column5: so every table in this experiment is the median over 5 such offsets.
